title: validate_headers check_date: .expect() panic in production code path
description: In post/validate_headers.rs, check_date() calls SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).expect('system clock before epoch'). This panics and crashes the reader process if the system clock is set behind the Unix epoch (e.g. VM time misconfiguration, NTP failure). A network-facing daemon must not panic on environmental failure. Fix: propagate the error as a 441 response instead of panicking.
